question: Does one frozen same-scene sibling exemplar resolve the sole class-agnostic proposal-ranking failure when candidate score is target-memory cosine minus sibling-memory cosine?

predecessor.observed_failure: The target was reachable at IoU 0.915791 in C16M1, but a right-side distractor scored 0.577516 versus 0.567368 for the highest-ranked IoU-at-least-0.5 target candidate; aggregate target retrieval was 2/3.
predecessor.single_change: Keep the exact frozen proposals, target memory and descriptor, and subtract cosine to the already frozen SIB32 same-scene sibling descriptor before ranking.

descriptor.feature: Unchanged separately normalized exact-box and 1.5x-context DINOv2 CLS concatenation.

memory.score: maximum target-memory cosine minus maximum sibling-memory cosine; coefficients are fixed at +1 and -1, with no fitted scale or threshold
memory.sibling_authority: Door instance 32 was selected by geometry before RGB or descriptor access in the new-family confirmation and is a different physical instance from target 16.

evaluation.proposal_authority: Reuse the predecessor's exact retained class-agnostic proposal rosters; do not rerun GroundingDINO.
evaluation.query_truth_role: The stored IoU fields remain evaluation-only and do not enter contrastive ranking.

decision_gate.interpretation: The contrastive top-one proposal must overlap target 16 at IoU at least 0.5 in all three unchanged query frames.

literature_motivation.use: Use distinct appearance memories and explicit distractor-aware scoring for generic indoor re-identification rather than treating every high target cosine as sufficient.
Retain proposal-to-template matching while adding a negative exemplar to separate visually similar non-target proposals.

forbidden_after_freeze: change proposals, target or sibling memory members, descriptor, crop, coefficients, tie-break or IoU gate
use target IoU to filter or rerank candidates
add another negative, adapter, threshold or post-outcome rescue on these frames
claim_boundary: This consumed same-scene Development test can establish only whether one preselected sibling negative memory repairs the observed C16 proposal-ranking failure. It cannot establish open-set rejection, unseen-scene or provider generalization, broad distractor coverage, named entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, deployment, user benefit, reliability or safety.
